title: Technician charts draw one line per ticked technician and nothing else
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. People: at least three technicians appear in this location's Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts (they have clocked time in the period you look at).
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
